title: Grateful Dead Live at Public Hall on 1973-12-06
lineage: SBD MR > 1 cass gen > DAT > (AUD patching)> CD > EAC > SHN

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a late‑'73 marathon featuring an epic 43‑minute Dark Star, soaring Here Comes Sunshine and smoking China Cat → Rider.
ai_review.review: The recording is a pristine soundboard source with A‑plus clarity (aside from a few audible AUD‑patch splices), letting the legendary late‑1973 performance shine.  The show is a high‑energy marvel highlighted by a massive Dark Star, blistering Here Comes Sunshine and flawless China Cat → Rider transitions, with Phil’s bass bombs and Keith’s electric piano/organ adding extra fire.  While a handful of reviewers note a sluggish first set, the overall vibe is unmistakably smoking and transcendent.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 60 reviews overwhelmingly praise both the musical performance (standout Dark Star, Here Comes Sunshine, China>Rider) and the recording quality (soundboard, crisp, A+), with only a few minor criticisms.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Crystal‑clear mix with rich bass and full band separation; occasional AUD‑patch splice noted but does not detract from overall superb sound. No major dropouts.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower → The Other One (Rider)
show_quality.setlist_flow: First set builds with solid jams but some feel sluggish; second set peaks with the marathon Dark Star > Eyes > Stella Blue sequence and a seamless transition into Here Comes Sunshine, delivering a tight, flowing arc.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly praised for inspired playing, soaring guitar tone, and powerful distortion bite on Loser; described as “really inspired”.
band_member_comments.Phil: Lauded for massive bass bombs, lead‑bass work, and high energy (“God of Thunder”, “on fire”), though a few note his volume can be overwhelming.
band_member_comments.Bob: Generally noted as present but occasionally buried in the mix; vocals clear when heard, no major complaints.
band_member_comments.Keys: Keith’s electric piano/organ highlighted as a key texture – described as “warbles”, “freaking killing it”, and essential to the Dark Star’s spacey vibe.
